text:
A mains-operated radio is a double-insulated appliance.
Which statement is correct?
A
The radio does not need a neutral connection.
B
The radio must be earthed.
C
The radio circuit is safe without a fuse or trip switch.
D
The outer casing of the radio cannot become live.

options.label: A
options.text: The radio does not need a neutral connection.

options.label: C
options.text: The radio circuit is safe without a fuse or trip switch.

options.label: D
options.text: The outer casing of the radio cannot become live.

subject: Physics
